name: band skier
description: A skiing motion with the band: swing both arms down and back while hinging at the hips. It works your lats, hips and core.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back past your hips as you hinge forward.
Return the arms up and stand tall in one smooth motion.
Keep your back flat and move with control.
